image_description: A close-up shot of a small, light-colored mustelid (likely a ferret or polecat) being held in human hands. The animal has cream/white fur on its face and chest, with darker fur visible on its lower body. It features a pink nose, dark eyes, and short rounded ears. The background is dark and out of focus.

Eyes are clearly visible, small relative to the head, and dark in color.
Ears are visible on the side of the head, appearing short and rounded as described.

While there is dark fur below, the specific 'brown dorsal / white ventral' pattern typical of a standard weasel is not clearly displayed; the animal appears to be a lighter morph (like a ferret or ermine transition) rather than the standard brown weasel description.
